tip.en: Release order is the safest start. Story order jumps back to 1943 and 1995. Placement of the newest titles is approximate.
tip.id: Urutan rilis paling aman untuk memulai. Urutan cerita melompat ke 1943 dan 1995. Posisi judul-judul terbaru masih perkiraan.

entries.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

tip.en: Story order is a different trip entirely: it opens in Age 737 with Bardock, and Daima — the newest series — belongs a year after the Buu arc. Side films are placed by arc, not by an official date.
tip.id: Urutan cerita jalannya jauh berbeda: dibuka di Age 737 lewat Bardock, dan Daima — serial terbaru — sebenarnya berlatar setahun setelah arc Buu. Film sampingan ditempatkan per arc, bukan dari tanggal resmi.

entries.title: Dragon Ball Z: Bardock - The Father of Goku

note.en: The earliest point in the whole chronology: Planet Vegeta falls and a baby Goku is sent to Earth.
note.id: Titik paling awal di seluruh kronologi: Planet Vegeta hancur dan bayi Goku dikirim ke Bumi.

entries.title: Dragon Ball: Curse of the Blood Rubies
Dragon Ball: Sleeping Princess in Devil's Castle
Dragon Ball: The Path to Power

note.en: Made for the series' tenth anniversary — the same first adventure, animated again.
note.id: Dibuat untuk ulang tahun kesepuluh serial — petualangan pertama yang sama, dianimasikan ulang.

note.en: Goku and Piccolo are still enemies and Gohan has no idea what he is.
note.id: Goku dan Piccolo masih musuh dan Gohan belum tahu kekuatannya.

entries.title: Dragon Ball Z Kai: The Final Chapters

note.en: The same episodes trimmed back to the manga, with no filler.
note.id: Episode yang sama dipangkas kembali ke manganya, tanpa filler.

entries.title: Dragon Ball Z: The World's Strongest
Dragon Ball Z: The Tree of Might
Dragon Ball Z: The Return of Cooler
Dragon Ball Z: Broly - The Legendary Super Saiyan
Dragon Ball Z: Broly - Second Coming
Dragon Ball Z: Wrath of the Dragon

note.en: Newest series, oldest slot: it lands a year after Buu, inside the ten-year gap that closes Z.
note.id: Serial terbaru, slot paling tua: berlatar setahun setelah Buu, di dalam jeda sepuluh tahun yang menutup Z.

entries.title: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods

note.en: Beerus wakes up. Dragon Ball Super retells this as its opening arc.
note.id: Beerus bangun. Dragon Ball Super menceritakan ulang ini sebagai arc pembukanya.

note.en: Frieza comes back. Super retells this as its second arc.
note.id: Frieza kembali. Super menceritakan ulang ini sebagai arc keduanya.

note.en: Broly was a film-only villain for 25 years; this is the version Toriyama wrote into the main story.
note.id: Broly 25 tahun cuma ada di film; versi inilah yang ditulis Toriyama masuk ke cerita utama.

note.en: Announced, not aired yet — the placement here is provisional.
note.id: Baru diumumkan, belum tayang — penempatannya di sini masih sementara.

entries.title: Dragon Ball Z: The History of Trunks

note.en: The timeline where the androids won and Trunks grew up alone.
note.id: Garis waktu tempat para android menang dan Trunks tumbuh sendirian.

note.en: Five years after Z ends. Made without Toriyama writing it, so most readings treat it as a branch rather than the main line.
note.id: Lima tahun setelah Z berakhir. Dibuat tanpa Toriyama menulisnya, jadi umumnya dianggap cabang, bukan garis utama.

entries.title: Dragon Ball GT: A Hero's Legacy

note.en: A promotional series built around card-game what-ifs, outside the main story.
note.id: Serial promosi dari skenario andai-andai permainan kartu, di luar cerita utama.

tip.en: The films follow the TV series era by era — Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos. Two things break the line: the 2019 CGI remake belongs right at the start, and from I Choose You! the films move into a timeline of their own.
tip.id: Filmnya mengikuti serial TV era demi era — Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos. Dua hal memutus garisnya: remake CGI 2019 posisinya justru di paling awal, dan sejak I Choose You! filmnya pindah ke garis waktu sendiri.

fork.title: Pokémon the Movie: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel

note.en: One library entry covering every era of the TV series, from 1997 to today.
note.id: Satu entri library yang mencakup seluruh era serial TV, dari 1997 sampai sekarang.

entries.title: Pokémon the Movie: Mewtwo Strikes Back - Evolution

note.en: A shot-for-shot CGI remake of the first film. Watch it instead of the original, not after it.
note.id: Remake CGI nyaris adegan per adegan dari film pertama. Tonton sebagai pengganti aslinya, bukan setelahnya.

note.en: Four episodes following Red, not Ash — a retelling of the Red and Green games rather than of the anime.
note.id: Empat episode mengikuti Red, bukan Ash — penceritaan ulang game Red dan Green, bukan animenya.

entries.title: Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One

note.en: The real second film, a 1999 Japanese release. Brock is absent, the only movie without him.
note.id: Film kedua yang sebenarnya, rilis Jepang 1999. Brock tidak ada, satu-satunya film tanpa dia.

entries.title: The Power of One: The Pokémon 2000 Movie Special

note.en: A half-hour promo special aired once on The WB before the second film opened in America: soundtrack performances and behind-the-scenes, no story. Never shown in Japan.
note.id: Acara promo setengah jam yang tayang sekali di The WB sebelum film kedua rilis di Amerika: penampilan soundtrack dan di balik layar, tanpa cerita. Tidak pernah tayang di Jepang.

entries.title: Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea

note.en: Opens the one run of films the wiki calls a trilogy: Darkrai, then Giratina, then Arceus.
note.id: Membuka satu-satunya rangkaian film yang disebut trilogi oleh wikinya: Darkrai, lalu Giratina, lalu Arceus.

entries.title: Pokémon: Giratina and the Sky Warrior
Pokémon: Arceus and the Jewel of Life

note.en: Closes the trilogy.
note.id: Menutup trilogi itu.

note.en: Zoroark is a Unova Pokémon, but the film is still a Sinnoh one: Ash is travelling with Dawn and Brock.
note.id: Zoroark itu Pokémon Unova, tetapi filmnya tetap film Sinnoh: Ash masih bepergian bersama Dawn dan Brock.

entries.title: Pokémon the Movie: White - Victini and Zekrom
Pokémon the Movie: Black - Victini and Reshiram

note.en: Black and White are two versions of one film released the same day, not two films — and the dub swaps the labels, so the Japanese Black is the English White.
note.id: Black dan White itu dua versi dari satu film yang rilis di hari yang sama, bukan dua film — dan dubnya menukar labelnya, jadi Black versi Jepang adalah White versi Inggris.

entries.title: Pokémon the Movie: Kyurem vs. the Sword of Justice
Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened
Pokémon the Movie: Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction
Pokémon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages
Pokémon the Movie: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel
Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!

note.en: The twentieth-anniversary film restarts the movie series: it retells Ash's first season in a continuity separate from the TV anime.
note.id: Film ulang tahun kedua puluh memulai ulang seri filmnya: menceritakan ulang musim pertama Ash di kontinuitas yang terpisah dari serial TV.

entries.title: Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us
Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle

note.en: Adapts the 2016 game, not the anime. Its writers said it shares the anime's world, but nothing in it fixes a point in time.
note.id: Mengadaptasi game 2016, bukan animenya. Penulisnya bilang dunianya sama dengan anime, tetapi tidak ada yang menentukan kapan latarnya.

tip.en: There is no official film chronology — Oda says none of the films are part of the story. So story order here means the earliest point you can watch each one without being spoiled, read off which crew is aboard.
tip.id: Tidak ada kronologi film resmi — Oda bilang tidak satu pun filmnya bagian dari cerita. Jadi urutan cerita di sini berarti titik paling awal kamu bisa menontonnya tanpa kena spoiler, dibaca dari siapa saja yang ada di kru.

entries.title: One Piece: Defeat the Pirate Ganzack!

note.en: The pilot OVA, made before the series: only Luffy, Zoro and Nami are aboard.
note.id: OVA perintis, dibuat sebelum serialnya: cuma Luffy, Zoro, dan Nami yang ada.

note.en: Eight episodes covering Romance Dawn through Arlong Park.
note.id: Delapan episode dari Romance Dawn sampai Arlong Park.

entries.title: One Piece Episode of East Blue

note.en: Four Straw Hats aboard, so it sits between Syrup Village and the Baratie.
note.id: Baru empat anggota, jadi letaknya antara Syrup Village dan Baratie.

entries.title: One Piece Episode of Nami: Tears of a Navigator and the Bonds of Friends

note.en: Framed as Nami remembering it years later, on the way to Fish-Man Island.
note.id: Dibingkai sebagai kenangan Nami bertahun-tahun kemudian, dalam perjalanan ke Fish-Man Island.

note.en: Zoro has his Loguetown blades and Usopp his goggles, so it is just before Reverse Mountain.
note.id: Zoro sudah memegang pedang Loguetown dan Usopp pakai gogglenya, jadi tepat sebelum Reverse Mountain.

entries.title: One Piece: Chopper's Kingdom on the Island of Strange Animals

note.en: Chopper is aboard but neither Vivi nor Robin is — a gap that barely exists in the series.
note.id: Chopper sudah ikut tetapi Vivi maupun Robin tidak ada — celah yang hampir tidak ada di serialnya.

entries.title: One Piece: Episode of Chopper Plus: Bloom in the Winter, Miracle Cherry Blossom

note.en: A what-if retelling: Robin, Franky and the Thousand Sunny are there, none of which existed yet at Drum Island.
note.id: Penceritaan ulang andai-andai: ada Robin, Franky, dan Thousand Sunny, yang semuanya belum ada waktu Drum Island.

entries.title: One Piece: The Desert Princess and the Pirates: Adventure in Alabasta

note.en: Robin has joined and the crew still sails the Going Merry, not yet knowing their new bounties.
note.id: Robin sudah bergabung dan kru masih memakai Going Merry, belum tahu hadiah buruan baru mereka.

entries.title: One Piece: Curse of the Sacred Sword

note.en: Here the crew does know the post-Alabasta bounties, which is what puts it after the previous film.
note.id: Di sini kru sudah tahu hadiah buruan pasca-Alabasta, itu yang menaruhnya setelah film sebelumnya.

entries.title: One Piece: Baron Omatsuri and the Secret Island
One Piece: Giant Mecha Soldier of Karakuri Castle
One Piece Episode of Merry: The Tale of One More Friend

note.en: Brook's first film, and the only one Oda wrote — though he still does not count it as part of the story.
note.id: Film pertama Brook, dan satu-satunya yang ditulis Oda — meski ia tetap tidak menghitungnya bagian cerita.

entries.title: One Piece "3D2Y": Overcome Ace's Death! Luffy's Vow to his Friends

note.en: No crew at all: Luffy training alone on Rusukaina with Rayleigh.
note.id: Tanpa kru sama sekali: Luffy berlatih sendirian di Rusukaina bersama Rayleigh.

note.en: Set on Sabaody as the crew drifts back together, told from the islanders' side.
note.id: Berlatar di Sabaody saat kru mulai berkumpul lagi, diceritakan dari sisi penduduknya.

entries.title: One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Hand Island Adventure

note.en: Despite the name it is an original story, not a retelling — the flashback to Luffy's beginning is only a part of it.
note.id: Meski namanya begitu, ini cerita orisinal, bukan penceritaan ulang — kilas balik awal Luffy cuma sebagiannya.

entries.title: One Piece Episode of Sabo: The Three Brothers' Bond - The Miraculous Reunion and the Inherited Will

note.en: A prequel, not a follow-up: it aired a week before the film and ends with the crew getting the card that takes them there.
note.id: Prekuel, bukan lanjutan: tayang seminggu sebelum filmnya dan berakhir saat kru mendapat kartu menuju ke sana.

entries.title: Luffy-senpai Support Project! Barto's Secret Room 4!
A Very Special Feature! Momonosuke's Road to Becoming a Great Shogun
One Piece - S00E46 - One Piece Film - Red

note.en: Jinbe sails with the crew and they use what they learned in Wano — though Big Mom is still an Emperor here, which the series had moved past.
note.id: Jinbe sudah berlayar bersama kru dan mereka memakai apa yang dipelajari di Wano — meski Big Mom masih jadi Kaisar di sini, hal yang sudah dilewati serialnya.

tip.en: First time? Watch in release order, the reveals land best. Story order is for a rewatch.
tip.id: Pertama kali? Tonton urutan rilis, kejutannya paling kena. Urutan cerita cocok untuk tonton ulang.

Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones

Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

note.en: It ends minutes before Star Wars begins.
note.id: Berakhir beberapa menit sebelum Star Wars dimulai.

entries.title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker

note.en: Separate stories outside the main timeline.
note.id: Kisah-kisah terpisah di luar garis waktu utama.

entries.title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi

tip.en: Release order keeps the mystery. Story order starts with Prometheus and ends with Resurrection.
tip.id: Urutan rilis menjaga misterinya. Urutan cerita dimulai dari Prometheus dan berakhir di Resurrection.

note.en: Set two years before Alien.
note.id: Berlatar dua tahun sebelum Alien.

note.en: Set between Alien and Aliens.
note.id: Berlatar di antara Alien dan Aliens.

tip.en: Two universes sharing a shelf: Snyder's DCEU, and the DCU that Superman (2025) restarted from scratch. Peacemaker is the one title that crosses between them.
tip.id: Dua semesta di rak yang sama: DCEU versi Snyder, dan DCU yang dimulai ulang dari nol lewat Superman (2025). Peacemaker satu-satunya yang menyeberang.

entries.title: Batman v Superman - Dawn of Justice

note.en: Snyder's own four-hour cut of the 2017 film, finished years after he left it.
note.id: Potongan empat jam versi Snyder sendiri dari film 2017, diselesaikan bertahun-tahun setelah ia meninggalkannya.

note.en: Made for the DCEU, then carried into the new DCU: James Gunn kept everything except the season-one finale's Justice League cameo.
note.id: Dibuat untuk DCEU lalu dibawa ke DCU baru: James Gunn mempertahankan semuanya kecuali cameo Justice League di akhir musim pertama.

note.en: Guy Gardner carries over from Superman (2025), which is how this one is tied to the rest.
note.id: Guy Gardner dibawa dari Superman (2025), itu yang menyambungkan serial ini dengan sisanya.

tip.en: The Rebuild films retell the TV series, then break away from it. The 3.0 prologue short came out last of all but belongs before 3.0.
tip.id: Film Rebuild menceritakan ulang serial TV lalu berbelok darinya. Film pendek prolog 3.0 rilis paling akhir tetapi posisinya sebelum 3.0.

note.en: A prologue short that only shipped with the final film's Japanese Blu-ray in 2023, yet is set before 3.0.
note.id: Film pendek prolog yang baru ikut Blu-ray Jepang film terakhir pada 2023, padahal berlatar sebelum 3.0.

tip.en: Ballerina sits between Chapter 3 and Chapter 4 in the story, and came out last.
tip.id: Ballerina berlatar di antara Chapter 3 dan Chapter 4, tetapi rilis paling akhir.

note.en: |Di antara Chapter 3 dan 4
note.id: |Di antara Chapter 3 dan 4

tip.en: Start with The Omen (1976). The First Omen is a prequel made in 2024, so it works best afterwards.
tip.id: Mulai dari The Omen (1976). The First Omen adalah prekuel buatan 2024, jadi paling pas ditonton setelahnya.

tip.en: Two separate continuities, not one line: Raimi's trilogy and the Amazing reboot never meet. Pick a lane and stay in it.
tip.id: Dua kontinuitas terpisah, bukan satu garis: trilogi Raimi dan reboot Amazing tidak pernah bertemu. Pilih satu jalur dan ikuti.

note.en: A reboot, not a sequel: same origin told again with a new cast.
note.id: Reboot, bukan sekuel: asal-usul yang sama diceritakan lagi dengan pemain baru.

tip.en: Two separate continuities: Nolan's trilogy ends for good, and The Batman starts over. Neither follows the other.
tip.id: Dua kontinuitas terpisah: trilogi Nolan selesai sepenuhnya, lalu The Batman memulai dari awal. Keduanya tidak saling melanjutkan.

note.en: A separate Gotham with its own cast and its own second year of Batman.
note.id: Gotham terpisah dengan pemain sendiri dan tahun kedua Batman versinya sendiri.

tip.en: Release order is the way in. Story order runs from the Targaryen civil war to the Game of Thrones era.
tip.id: Urutan rilis adalah pintu masuk. Urutan cerita berjalan dari perang saudara Targaryen sampai era Game of Thrones.
